entities.name: Deidamia
entities.description: A non-binary witch from Innistrad known for pumpkin carving and nurturing hope.

entities.name: Harvesttide Festival
entities.description: A festival where people gathered under the ancient Celestus.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A hero who arrived at the festival.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Leader of the werewolf pack that attacked the festival.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A witch killed in the massacre.

events.summary: Heroes including Arlinn Kord arrived at the Harvesttide Festival.
events.quote: heroes, Arlinn Kord among them, arrived

events.summary: Tovolar's werewolf pack attacked the festival in a massacre that killed many, including Katilda; Deidamia survived.
events.quote: an attack from Tovolar's werewolf pack, leading to a massacre that claimed many lives

events.summary: Deidamia tended to the wounded and attended a meeting where heroes and witches strategized.
events.quote: Deidamia was seen among those who tended to the wounded and sick

relations.note: His werewolf pack attacked the festival Deidamia attended.
relations.quote: an attack from Tovolar's werewolf pack
